Product Description

Embark on a curated, multi-sensory journey. Three complementary scents are carefully selected and layered into one vessel to craft a unique fragrance offering that evolves as the candle burns. The Pluswick Innovation wick enhances the sensory experience with a distinctive crackle and intriguing glow. A coveted gift for yourself or a friend.

    Important information

    Safety Information

    Always keep a burning candle within sight. Never leave a burning candle unattended. Keep candles away from flammable materials. Do not burn candle for more than 4 hours at a time. Always trim wick to 1/8 inch before lighting. Do not use this candle outdoors.

    • B&V.82
      4 out of 5 stars
      I really loved, most the features of this candle.
      Reviewed in the United States on April 16, 2023
      Color: ShorelineSize: 16oz
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      So let's start with the smell, it was beautiful and filled a rather large room.

      I love the woodwick candles! This was the first time I've purchased, a larger wicked candle if that makes sense? The candle is oblong so the wicked is close to 2" wide. I love the sound and light ambience the woodwicks put off, they are one of a kind and I think they are the most amazing candles all around. The reason I'm not giving 5 ☆'s is due to 2 reasons.

      1st the candles do not last long at all, unfortunately they burn in less then 1/2 the time a candle 1/2 is size does.

      2nd it is a huge, HUGE fire hazard!

      These larger wicks burn like you've lit a stick on fire in your living room! I burn my new candles on top of my wood stove to see how they burn before placing them out of direct eye site. There is nothing else on, near or above my wood stove and thank God for that because it blew my mind how this candle burned! The flame is gigantic in comparison to any other candle, it almost seems like a candle you would light for the fire not the smell?

      I highly recommend WOODWICK candles, but if you go with a larger wick one keep in mind it burns like a fire not a candle and keep it in sight at all times while it's burning!

      Other then these reasons its a wonderful product and the sound! I have to mention the sound of these candles, it sounds like a camp fire on low volume 😃

      I HIGHLY RECOMMEND WOODWICK CANDLES!!

    • Aurora Scott
      5 out of 5 stars
      The Candle That Took Me Camping Without Leaving My Couch
      Reviewed in the United States on September 13, 2025
      Color: ShorelineSize: 16oz
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Okay, listen. This isn’t just a candle—it’s basically a personality. It’s huge enough to make me feel like I got my money’s worth, and when I lit it, the wick started crackling like I’d just built a five-star campfire in my living room (minus the mosquitoes and questionable s’mores hygiene).

      The scent situation? Wild. This candle has three layers, three different colors, and three totally different vibes. It’s like aromatherapy speed-dating: one minute I’m sniffing warm vanilla woods, then boom—suddenly I’m transported to a citrus grove, and before I can process that, I’m chilling in a pine forest wondering if I should be chopping firewood. My nose has never been so entertained.

      The wide wick is basically the MVP—no tunneling, no sad little wax puddles. Just big, bold, “I’m a candle and I know it” energy. Honestly, if this candle had legs, it would probably roast marshmallows for me.

      10/10 would buy again. In fact, I’m low-key worried this thing is going to give me main-character energy every time I light it.

    About this Item

    • Our fragrance curators have layered the scents of Melon Blossom, Coastal Sunset, and Palo Santo to envision a coastal getaway
    • Features three complementary fragrances that create an intriguing scent experience as the layers melt together
    • The patented Pluswick Innovation wick enhances the experience with a distinctive crackling sound
    • Hourglass shaped vessel creates an increased wax pool for greater fragrancing
    • Made with a premium blend of soy and paraffin wax

    Product Description

    Embark on a curated, multi-sensory journey. Three complementary scents are carefully selected and layered into one vessel to craft a unique fragrance offering that evolves as the candle burns. The Pluswick Innovation wick enhances the sensory experience with a distinctive crackle and intriguing glow. A coveted gift for yourself or a friend.

    Important Information

    Safety Information

    Always keep a burning candle within sight. Never leave a burning candle unattended. Keep candles away from flammable materials. Do not burn candle for more than 4 hours at a time. Always trim wick to 1/8 inch before lighting. Do not use this candle outdoors.
